thread:
Mia (Support): FYI — CustCorp procurement replied to our billing thread. They say they will not accept any invoice until we have an official PO that contains their GL/cost-center and the signed SOW reference. They also want vendor registration in their Coupa portal.

Olivia (SE): Got it. Do we have the SOW countersigned by their procurement team? I remember a version signed by their PM, but maybe not the procurement stamp.

Mia (Support): Quote from their email: 'We require PO with cost center (42-IT-2026), project code (PROJ-42) and SOW ref SOW-9987 on the invoice. Vendor must be onboarded in Coupa (vendor id 78321) before Accounts Payable will process.'

Juan (Billing): This is a hard block on invoicing on their side. We can prepare a proforma to help their internal approvals but we can't post an official invoice to AR without the PO number. Also need vendor onboarding proof (screenshot or vendor id) for our records.

Sophie (Finance): Two quick checklist items for us to close: 1) Confirm SOW is countersigned by CustCorp procurement; 2) Obtain their PO number and vendor registration confirmation (Coupa vendor id or portal approval). For US customers we usually also ask for W-9; for EU customers we ask for VAT/EORI. Do we know their jurisdiction?

Mia (Support): They're EMEA but billing legal asked to include VAT handling. Customer explicitly wrote 'include VAT registration no. if available, otherwise we will withhold tax per local rules'.

Olivia (SE): OK — let's offer a path forward. Suggestion to reply to procurement: short options and next steps. Draft reply below — feel free to edit: 

---
Hi CustCorp procurement team,

We can help accelerate your internal PO process with either: 
1) A proforma invoice that includes the SOW reference and the requested cost-center/project fields (this is for approval only and will not post to accounts receivable until a PO number is provided), or
2) We can hold the final invoice and attach the signed SOW + vendor onboarding docs once you supply the official PO number.

Example fields we will include on your invoice if you provide them: 
```
PO: PO-2026-8891
Cost center: 42-IT-2026
Project: PROJ-42
SOW ref: SOW-9987
Net terms: Net 30
VAT / EORI: [if provided]
```

Please confirm which you'd prefer and send the PO number and/or vendor confirmation (Coupa vendor id 78321 or vendor onboarding acceptance). We can also attach our W-9 / vendor form on request.

Thanks,
Redwood Billing Team
---

Olivia (SE): I recommend sending that and attaching the signed SOW we have on file plus a completed vendor onboarding form.

AccountingBot: Automated checklist status: [SOW attached: NO] [Vendor onboarding: NO] [PO number: NO].

Juan (Billing): I'll prepare the proforma and attach the SOW draft and vendor onboarding form. Once they reply with PO+vendor id we will convert to an official invoice. If Procurement insists on a PO before we even issue a proforma, we can point them to the vendor registration link and offer a short intro to our vendor team to speed things along.

Sophie (Finance): Flagging potential delay on revenue recognition until PO is received — will note in the weekly revenue forecast. If customer requests an exception (invoice now without PO) we need documented written approval from their Finance lead; escalate to legal only if they push for billing without standard docs.

Mia (Support): I'll send the draft reply to procurement and cc Olivia + Juan. Will update this thread when they respond. :thumbsup:

Juan (Billing): Action items assigned: Juan - create proforma + attach SOW and vendor form; Olivia - confirm countersigned SOW or get signature walk-through; Sophie - hold for finance note on recognition; Mia - send reply to procurement and gather PO/vendor id. Target: 3 business days to get PO or vendor confirmation.

Mia (Support): Update — sent. Including link to proforma PDF I created: https://files.redwood.internal/proforma/pc-78321.pdf (internal link).
